output.population: General adult populations in prospective studies and clinical trials, excluding participants with chronic disease in the included analyses
output.intervention_or_exposure: Higher dietary fibre and whole-grain intake
output.comparator: Lower dietary fibre and whole-grain intake
output.outcome: Mortality, cardiovascular outcomes, type 2 diabetes, cancer, and cardiometabolic risk factors
output.effect: Observational data suggested 15-30% lower risk across several critical outcomes for higher fibre intake; clinical trials showed lower bodyweight, systolic blood pressure and total cholesterol, with greatest observed risk reduction around 25-29 g/day of fibre.
output.applicability_boundary: Population-level evidence for people without chronic disease in included analyses; mixes prospective observational outcomes with randomized risk-factor trials.
